answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> The Holy Quran Question ID: 168144 Country: India Title: Reciting particular Surah daily Question: Can we recite Surah Yaseen daily. Someone told me reciting Surah Yaseen daily is bid'ah. Reciting Surah Yaseen daily is not Sunnah. Answer ID: 168144 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 439/369/D=05/1440) It is narrated in a Hadith: خير العمل ما ديم عليه It means that the best of deeds is that which is done consistently and without a gap. Also Allah says in the Holy Quran: مَن جَاء بِالْحَسَنَةِ فَلَهُ عَشْرُ أَمْثَالِهَا Whoever comes with a good deed will receive ten times as much. It is a good deed to read Surah Yaseen and great rewards have been promised on reading it; thus it would be excellent to read it daily. It is wrong to regard it as bida’h. You may read daily. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
